# Lonko Digital

> Lonko Digital is a growth intelligence and optimization company building technology that helps businesses understand what is happening across their digital marketing, why it matters, and what to look at next.

Lonko Digital is an early-stage company. This website is informational and does not currently offer public customer accounts, subscriptions, or commercial software access. No Lonko product is available to customers today.

## What exists today

- Paid growth: Building. Google Ads is a private reference implementation under continued private validation. LinkedIn Ads integration is under development. Live API data delivery has not yet been validated. Status: In Development. Meta Ads is planned. None of these is available to customers.
- Search, AI discovery and market research: Planned
- Analytics and tracking: Planned
- Web, conversion and lifecycle: Planned
- Business economics: Planned
